name: West Virginia
agency: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles (WV DMV)
permitAge: 15 (Level 1 instruction permit, ages 15 to under 18); parent or guardian signs the application

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, certified by a parent, guardian or responsible adult over 21; or a driver education course (W. Va. Code 17B-2-3a)
teen.holdPermit: 180 days conviction-free (statute); DMV says six months infraction-free
teen.nightLimit: Level 1: drive only 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. Level 2: unsupervised only 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. needs a licensed driver 21 or older, except work, school-sanctioned activity, religious event or emergency
teen.passengerLimit: Level 1: no more than two additional non-family passengers. Level 2: first six months no passengers under 20 unless family; second six months no more than one passenger under 20
teen.phone: Level 1 and Level 2 holders under 18: no wireless device at all except to call 911. All drivers: no holding a phone; calls hands-free or voice-operated only (17C-14-15).

bac.under21: 0.02 (misdemeanor, 17C-5-2); Level 1 permit holders: no measurable alcohol

notes: Level 1 supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older (or driver education / driving school instructor), the only other occupant of the front seat.
Level 3 full license at 17 after 12 months conviction-free on Level 2.

Knowledge test: may be taken online on a computer with keyboard, mouse and camera (no phones); wait seven days after a failure; $7.50 per attempt (DMV). Question count and pass mark not found on a DMV page; third-party sites say 25 questions with 19 or 20 to pass, which conflict.

Move over law (17C-14-9a, since 2003): slow down and change lanes if safe for stopped emergency vehicles, including police, EMS, fire, safety service patrols and tow trucks; up to $500 and/or 60 days jail.

School bus (17C-12-7): stop when meeting or overtaking a stopped bus with lights flashing; the only exception found is a controlled-access highway with the bus on a different roadway. No divided-highway question written.
